'''Leral Anan''' is a woman who lives in [[Ebou Dar]], [[Altara]]. She is one of [[Setalle Anan]] and [[Jasfer Anan]]'s daughters (the youngest, as Marah is mentioned to be the eldest and [[Frielle]] the middle daughter) and works at her mother's inn, The Wandering Woman. She has more than one brother, one of them Ross.

[[Vanin]] and [[Corevin]] tell Mat that [[Olver]] went out to the stables with a book and one of the innkeeper's daughters, Leral, after another girl spanked him for pinching her bottom. He brightened up when Leral let him hold her hand.
